QuestInfo.name: [Erel Light] Shadows Give Chase
QuestInfo.0: What you heard during the meeting is bothering you... #p9201718# shouldn't be far. Catch up to him.
QuestInfo.1: Why do those enemies seem so familiar? And...what was that light?
QuestInfo.2: You were almost overcome by your enemies...but just as you lost consciousness, you were rescued by a warm and enveloping light. What could it be?
